rationale: No existing spec covers the billing-group member remove flow. The only billing E2E (Onboarding/billing.spec.js) covers the billing landing/trial strip and tab presence, never the /billings/billing_group payer view, the remove icon, its confirmation dialog, or the DELETE member call. The feature is its own page/route, so a new spec at the run-context spec_path (Management/billingGroup.spec.js, playwright_group Management) is correct. Register it in the Management testfolder of ci_matrix.json.
